notes.title: 1.00.1 Default Language Fix Patch
notes.notes:
We have made English the default language and enabled language selection in the experimental menu in Settings.

The quality of localizations is not upto our expected standards yet but is available for testing and feedback in non-english languages.

Thanks for playing the game and sharing feedback about your experiences. Loving the feedback we are getting and also clarifying value of next set of things to target for us!

notes.title: 0.95.2 Patch Update
notes.notes:
We are back with a small quality of life patch!

Changes
[list]
[*]Animated tile for ability attacks, makes it clear and draws attention to where enemies are going to attack.
[*]Lore book snaps to lore entries if there are any unseen entries.
[*]Basketball mini-game improvement to controls and dragging in opposite directions. 
[*]Engine upgrades.
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Behind the scenes we have been working towards making the combat deeper and more meaningful. We are also evaluating and prototyping what future directions the combat could go in with the narrative being a major part and how it ties into combat with different types of games that you can build over pure turn based combat for everything!

We haven't said this enough but we are so glad and thankful for the support we have had in our journey in making and updating Gamedev Beatdown!

notes.title: The Big Boss Update - 0.95
notes.notes:
We are back with a massive new update! We focused on several experiential as well as mechanical systems this time around.

The big boss finally makes an appearance in the game, and you can now get your friends and viewers on a twitch stream to vote for your choices. 

Many quality of life improvements and new strategic decisions with the employees themselves joining in the battles are part of this update.

No more repetitive location and combat music. Yes, we read the reviews. We hope you review the game and keep sharing your feedback.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*]Mega Boss Fight
[*]New music for each location and department
[*]Brand new Basketball mini-game
[*]Twitch Voting
[*]Full controller support
[*]Extensive updates to the employee system
[list]
    [*]Employees now show their character types. When you fight and call for support, your teams' employees show up, allowing for a very customizable combat experience and difficulty.
    [*]You can hire higher leveled employees now as you move to new locations.
    [*]You can hire the uber mini-boss employees, too, now.
    [*]Employees from other teams can show up as guest support or opponents when they agree or disagree with your choices.
[/list]
[*]The boss fight can impact the endings, giving you a final chance to change your studio's future.
[*]New employee types for a total of 45 characters (a lot more uniques with procedurally generated personalities and preferences)
[/list]

[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*]You can now see project stats in the event screens to allow you to make more informed decisions
[*]New controller icon sets for Xbox, Playstation, Switch, and Steam controllers
[*]Input icon helpers added to most  areas of the game, making it much faster to play the game
[*]Merged the player and budget tabs for a more informative player screen
[*]New category to configure controller actions for mini-games
[*]Parallax effect in combat backgrounds and various other places
[*]Moving from node to node gives feedback now before triggering the map action
[*]The achievement is nice and all but made it easier to end the run if the player chooses to continue after bankruptcy and cannot get out of it.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Project stat requirements should be slightly more reasonable now
[*]Fixed the gains from being in crunch mode being more apparent
[*]Summoned employees come in with a higher stress tolerance
[*]Rage damage rebalanced, higher levels are still overpowered, lower levels less so.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed some items incorrectly staying equipped
[*]Fixed faded-out backgrounds when moving to the co-working space for the first time.
[*]Multiple runs would sometimes remember some player actions making some endings popup up more often.
[*]The hiring screen goes back to the original position after hiring an employee.
[/list]

Stay safe out there!

Tejas

notes.title: Hotkeys + Update 0.93.6
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone! We are back with a quick new update for Gamedev Beatdown that adds support for hotkeys and addresses some issues with events and items!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added support for action hotkeys in combat. 
[*] Improvements to health items and the player window in the laptop now shows max health.
[*] Fixed some events showing up with the production department before it is unlocked.
[*] Fixed bug with salary calculations in some locations, no more free employees!
[*] Improved item descriptions to be clearer.
[*] Updated super abilities to be more unique, with dealing damage in a row (default energy beam), column (Charged punch) or a single unit for massive damage (Mecha punch).
[/list]

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Update 0.92.0 is Out Now!
notes.notes:
A new update is here for Gamedev Beatdown and we have made a lot of improvements this time!

The feedback on our Discord has been excellent and very helpful! Let us know what you think about the new items and mob behavior. 

Don't forget to leave a [b]review[/b] for the game! It is very important on Steam and it helps get us more exposure and new players to make a decision for trying out the game!

[b]New[/b]
[list][*]New mob art for melee and ranged grunts and mini-boss variants for all departments.
[*]Manual - New Item for Summoning allies at the start of combat
[*]Plushie - Grants damage reduction to the player
[*]RAM - Allow directly targeting mobs in the back row.
[*]Tank Mobs start rounds with double shield actions.
[*]Ranged mobs move positions to unoccupied tiles after attacks.
[*]Mini-boss ranged mobs move positions to unoccupied tiles after each turn.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*]Reinstated item equip limits for locations.
[*]Reinstated employee hiring limits per location.
[*]Items don't always auto-equip if already maximum items are equipped.
[*]Cannot attack units in the back row if someone is in front. RAM item can ignore this behaviour.
[*]Slightly balanced project stat requirements.
[*]Behind the scenes improvements to event and choice management. Can now show additional options based on player choices.
[*]Can measure more granularly personality stats for the player based on the choices made instead of simpler states.
[*]Mouse over updates the current selected node in the progress graph.
[*]Mobs have more predictable action patterns for most battles.
[*]Project launch pay-outs tweaked a tiny bit for some projects.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed total completed projects on project launch showing total projects completed in that run instead of throughout the game.
[*]Fixed Cancel button not showing up in target selection phases. Shortcut (Esc) to cancel was still functional.
[*]Items obtained from event rewards were not syncing with items in the inventory purchased from the shop and behaving oddly.
[*]Project progress graph was not resetting to the start when starting a new project, will align properly now.
[*]Employees that got promoted and are still leaving don't show the promotion anymore. It's better to not tell players that the retention effort's failed. ;)
[*]Character Selection screen is properly localized now.
[*]Fixed ground attack notifiers getting reset when multiple mobs were attacking the same tile.
[*]Improved hitboxes on mobs for easier targeting.
[*]Cannot keep playing with negative funds anymore. 
[*]Other text and localization fixes for areas that were not very clear.
[*]Single project on the beginning of Act 1 is pre-selected, some players did not find it intuitive to have to select the project first since it was the only option.
[*]Fixed eco actions for mobs.
[*]Fixed a couple of location based achievements that weren't showing up on steam.
[/list]

Tejas

notes.title: Patch Update 0.91.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We are back with an update that addresses some experiential improvements and a couple of bugs.

I was pleasantly surprised by how many people were playing the game with languages other than English, considering the support for other languages is for testing only. If you can get past the broken translations, though, it made for some fun moments where players would try to figure out some of the references and jokes that didn't translate well.

[b]Changelog v0.91.4[/b]
[list]
[*]You can rage at the opponents now instead of the game. Fixed the rage ability not dealing damage.
[*]Changed audio for event vocalization, it is much more pleasing to the ears, unlike the earlier squeaky version that got annoying on higher volumes.
[*]Fixed missing localizations for some languages, since people are playing the game in other languages might as well have all text available.
[*]Fixed the rain getting into everyone's clothes and making them wet in the streets combat arena. Through the power of tech wizardry, the rain goes behind the player and the mobs, and they can perform at their full dry capacity.
[*]Balance updates for stat requirements for end level games.
[*]Some internal optimizations so that we can get you updates faster.
[/list] 

Have fun beating up the dissenters and keep sending us feedback!

Tejas

notes.title: Patch Update 0.91.3
notes.notes:
Thank you for purchasing Gamedev Beatdown and supporting us small-time indies,

We hope for full participation by our community, and in turn, we will do everything possible to make sure our players have an enjoyable experience in the game.

One way we can do that is to respond to issues that players have reported with the utmost speed. Therefore, we are already here with a patch to fix some quality of life issues and one crucial bug with display resolutions.

[b]Changelog v0.91.3[/b]
[list][*]Fixed Display Resolutions being moody, it will properly detect default resolution and set the resolution to what you ask it to.
[*]Fixed flickering of happiness tooltip and clipping of some others at the edge of the screen.
[*]Mob quips on special abilities expand uniformly instead of in a single direction to avoid clipping out of the screen when mobs are at the edge.
[/list]

If you want to get in touch and want faster response times, our [url=https://discord.gg/rSRy7fg]discord server[/url] is the best place to get a hold of us.

Thanks once again!

Tejas
